No metrics or tracing stack exists. Observability relies on Frappe's built-in mechanisms:

- **Error Log doctype:** `frappe.log_error(...)` is the main way failures get recorded (about 15 call sites). It is used in schedulers, notifications and patches. Usual forms: `frappe.log_error(frappe.get_traceback(), _("Short Title"))` or `frappe.log_error(title="...")`. Give the log a clear title.
- **Logger:** `frappe.logger().info/error(...)` appears in a few places, mostly setup and patches (`setup/patient_duplicate_check.py`, `patches/v15_0/setup_patient_duplicate_check_rules.py`), plus one parse-failure log in patient_appointment.
- **User feedback in Desk:** `frappe.show_alert` and `frappe.msgprint`.
- **Code-scanning signals:** CodeQL runs weekly and on develop. Semgrep and Codecov coverage run in CI.

Do not add `print()` debugging. The pre-commit `debug-statements` hook blocks leftover debugger calls.
